title: Propositional logic: from formulas to clauses
description: Does {p ∨ q ↔ ¬r, ¬p → s, ¬t → q, s ∧ t → u} entail r → u? The set with the negated conclusion is turned into clauses and refuted with resolution and with DPLL; the truth table shows that it has no model.

title: First-order semantic tableau with equality
description: In a monoid where every element has a right inverse, an element x such that x·y = y for every y is the identity e. The semantic tableau (with equality) of the axioms and the negated claim.

title: Automated provers: commutative groups
description: In a group where x·x = e for every x, the operation is commutative: Prover9 and E prove it. With x·x·x·x = e it is not: Mace4 finds a counter-model of 8 elements.

title: Eight queens as a SAT problem
description: The puzzle is written as a propositional constraint satisfaction problem, translated to DIMACS and solved with a SAT solver. Open the CSP panel to see and edit the constraints.
